articles.title: Renewal of Bilateral Local Currency Swap Agreement With the People's Bank of China
articles.description: Media Release Number 2026-21: The Reserve Bank of Australia and People’s Bank of China have renewed the Bilateral Local Currency Swap Agreement for a further five years.
